# Review: FAFF-7001 (two-phase adversarial review)

## Phase 1: standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Verdict: `pass`, no findings.

## Adversarial findings — not obtained (malformed fallback config)

- `faff adversarial-backends --consumer code_review` exited 2: `adversarial.fallbacks is not valid JSON: Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1 (line 1 column 2)`.
- No backend chain could be assembled, so `review-call.mjs` was not invoked. The Phase 2 checkpoint stays at `pending`.

A broken config has to fail loudly. It must not quietly fall back to a primary-only chain or pass without a second opinion. The signal is `needs-human`: fix the `adversarial.fallbacks` value and re-run the adversarial review. The unreviewed diff replaces `db.deleteOwned(id)` with `db.delete(id)` in `src/store.js`, which touches the ownership check named in the spec and in prior finding P1.

```faff-contract:review-verdict
{"signal":"needs-human","findings":[{"title":"Malformed adversarial.fallbacks JSON in adversarial config","location":".faff/config.yaml","action":"Rewrite adversarial.fallbacks as a valid JSON array of backend objects, then re-run the adversarial review.","location_present":true,"action_present":true,"source":"adversarial","disposition":"open","disposition_rationale":"faff adversarial-backends exit 2: adversarial.fallbacks is not valid JSON; no backend chain was assembled."}]}
```
